objectives.text: Trace which registered route and handler a request reaches, and select the Context call that reads a path parameter, a query parameter or a JSON body
Write and register a GET or POST handler that sets the status and returns JSON, and pass its public check in the required guided local run
Map an exception to a status code and JSON body with an exception handler, and pass its public check in the required guided local run

minutes.basis: Measured in the http-and-javalin module PR on the authored artifact.html with the frozen authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py (sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f): modeledP50 9.24 (1019 words, 16 code lines, interactions {"confidence": 2, "drag": 1, "explore": 2, "mcq": 1, "predict": 1}). modeledWorstPath 14.99 = P50 plus the worst required route per interactive unit: the predict unit +0.25 min in all (reading every option's explanation); the Context-call sort unit +1 min in all (4 items × 0.25 min: two wrong tries, then the revealed explanation, for each item); the POST-handler editor unit +1.5 min in all (typing a block handler, then two runs that fail to compile or answer with the wrong status or body before all three requests behave); the exception-handler editor unit +1.5 min in all (typing an exception handler, then two runs that answer 500, a text body or a fixed message before every request behaves); the apply check +1.5 min in all (two wrong graded attempts, reading the retry representation and both feedback sets). Budget and aboutLabel are ceil(max(P50, worst path)) under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, raised from the intake planning value 15 and within the 15-minute cap.
